chat:
Maya: Coast weekend is on. Leave San Jose Saturday morning, stay around Big Sur, head back Sunday.
Maya: McWay Falls is the one stop I care about. The waterfall onto the beach.
Sam: McWay Falls parking is tiny. I would rather skip it than sit in a turnout.
Jordan: Big Sur Bakery for breakfast Saturday. The wood oven stuff is the reason I come.
Maya: Bakery first, then the falls if we still want them.
Sam: Bixby Bridge on the drive down, photos only, not a long stop.
Jordan: Pfeiffer Beach if we have time. Purple sand, and it is a detour.
Sam: Mystery Cafe in Carmel came up in another chat. I have never been.
Jordan: Nepenthe for dinner Saturday if we are doing the view. It is the expensive one.
Maya: Dinner at Nepenthe is a treat, not the default. We can drop it if the day runs long.
